messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: update problems
parts:
Hi,
I have had some problems with some of the functions since the update. In
particular, I have gotten errors that there are no applicable methods
for some functions that act on ResidualFile and WeightsFile objects. I
put the three things below.
Thanks,
Elizabeth

#1) This isn't exactly an error, but a confirmation about the new code
for calculateResidualSet.ProbeLevelModel. Part of the new code is as
follows:
if (TRUE) {
cdfData <- loadCache(key, dirs = dirs)
if (!is.null(cdfData))
verbose && cat(verbose, "Found indices cached on file")
}
It use to be 'if(!force){...}' and I was just wondering if it is suppose
to be 'if(TRUE)' in which case it is always done (and regardless of the
value of force)

#2) getResidualSet has the following error:
>getResidualSet(plm)
...
Retrieving residual file #35 of 35 (BR_ZR75B_14_v1_WT)...done
Retrieving probe-level residuals from data set...done
Getting chip-effect set from data set...done
Error in getParameters(rf, ...) : no applicable method for "getParameters"
> traceback()
11: getParameters(rf, ...)
10: getParameters.ResidualSet(this)
9: getParameters(this)
8: getParametersAsString.ResidualSet(this)
7: getParametersAsString(this)
6: paste(getParametersAsString(this), collapse = ", ")
5: as.character.ResidualSet(x)
4: as.character(x)
3: print(as.character(x))
2: print.Object(NA)
1: print(NA)

#3) calculateWeights has the following error
> ws<-calculateWeights(plm)
...
Calculating PLM residuals...done
Calculating PLM weights...
Error in findUnitsTodo(wf, ...) : no applicable method for "findUnitsTodo"
Calculating PLM weights...done
> traceback()
5: findUnitsTodo(wf, ...)
4: findUnitsTodo.WeightsSet(ws, units = units)
3: findUnitsTodo(ws, units = units)
2: calculateWeights.ExonRmaPlm(plm, verbose = -5)
1: calculateWeights(plm, verbose = -5)

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] update problems
parts:
Hi,

Just another comment about the problem with the weights. There is also a
problem in getFile() which is creating the same problem for
'getCellIndices.WeightsSet' as well as 'findUnitsTodo.WeightsSet'.
Namely, the code uses 'wf <- getFile(this, idx)' and then calls function
for wf. However, getFile(ws) is returning an object of class
'AffymetrixCelFile' not class 'WeightsFile'; so the xxx.WeightsFile() is
not being called, but rather xxx.AffymetrixCelFile() which doesn't
exist. Didn't ws$files use to return objects of class 'WeightsFile'?
That's how the residual class works.

Anyway, the end result is that I can't do anything with my WeightsSet --
for example readUnits doesn't work. Is there a way that I can go back to
a previous version until this is fixed? I'm really stuck otherwise and I
need to be able to read my weights data this weekend.

Thanks,
Elizabeth

> class(getFile(rs,1))
[1] "ResidualFile" "ParameterCelFile" "AffymetrixCelFile"
"AffymetrixFile"
[5] "Object"
> class(getFile(ws,1))
[1] "AffymetrixCelFile" "AffymetrixFile" "Object"
> class(rs$files[[1]])
[1] "ResidualFile" "ParameterCelFile" "AffymetrixCelFile"
"AffymetrixFile"
[5] "Object"
> class(ws$files[[1]])
[1] "AffymetrixCelFile" "AffymetrixFile" "Object"
